steps: Fill out the secured referral form on cmecreditunion.org/member-referral-rewards with your family member's or friend's information.
Your referral joins CME CU and opens any type of loan or a checking account with $500 or more in it.
You earn a $25 CME CU Reward$ for each qualifying referral.
timing: Payout timing not specified on the official page.
when_cash_arrives: Payout timing not specified on the official page. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
